zoe (Mkt Ops): Kickoff: need to lock webinar slate + 3 abstracts by Thu EOD. Target mid-May, NA/EU friendly. Options: benchmark deep-dive, hands-on lab, buyer case study. React :one/:two/:three: or add ideas.
ryan (Growth): :one: + :two:. Hands-on lab drives stronger intent; we can gate sandbox for MQL tagging.
mira (Content): Ill draft 3 short abstracts (eng/pm/exec) after we pick direction. Prefer benchmark deep-dive for follow-up nurture.
jordan (Speaker Ops): Note: need 2 backups per speaker. Suggest Priya (infra), Omar (customer), Lena (PM). Priya prefers afternoon demos.
evan (Product): If we demo, show same prompt on two routing policies (latency-first vs cost-first) so tradeoffs are obvious.
zoe (Mkt Ops): First-pass run-of-show (50m): 00:00-00:05 host intro; 00:05-00:20 primer; 00:20-00:35 live demo + configs; 00:35-00:45 customer example; 00:45-00:50 CTA + trial credits.
jordan (Speaker Ops): Action items: mira abstracts (Wed), jordan confirm speakers + backups (Wed), ryan set lead routing + utm (Thu). Lock if no objections by EOD.
